units.title: Sequences and series
units.why: Sequences model repeated change, finance and patterns that occur throughout mathematics and science.
misconceptions: using an arithmetic formula for a geometric sequence
confusing a term with a sum
practice: Explain the difference between sequence and series.
solutions: a sequence lists terms; a series adds terms

videoPackage.title: Arithmetic and geometric sequences
videoPackage.transcript: We compare changes between terms, select the correct model, derive the general term, and distinguish listing terms from adding them.
